verdict.rationale: OpenRouter is fundamentally an API product: extensive first-party docs cover a single unified API endpoint, chat completions, streaming, tool calling, model routing/fallbacks, key management, and an OpenAPI spec confirmed live via probe (openapi.json, HTTP 200). Community evidence corroborates real-world programmatic use (switching models via same API key, key management, billing caps). Missing for 10: no independent third-party API documentation/benchmarking site or SDK changelog corroboration beyond OpenRouter's own docs and community anecdotes.
